relatedPosts.title: Creating a browser-based recording tool with flask + recorder.js + p5.js on TypeScript
relatedPosts.description: Create a simple recorder using recorder.js, a wrapper for the Web Audio API. Implement the UI by writing p5.js, the browser version of Processing, in TypeScript.

relatedPosts.title: Easy Multimodal Music Search with S3 Vectors
relatedPosts.description: Building a multimodal music search system with Amazon S3 Vectors (GA July 2025) and CLAP (Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining) on the MusicCaps dataset, faithful to the actual repository implementation.

relatedPosts.title: Generate a Table of Contents for Multiple .ipynb Files
relatedPosts.description: I keep my learning records and boilerplates as a cheat sheet collection on my GitHub ([Repository](https://github.com/atsukoba/cheatbooks)), and I save multiple notebooks directly under the same directory. So, I wrote a script to extract the parts written in Markdown within each of those notebooks.
